name: Format Markdown for Telegram
description: Converts Markdown, as a model writes it, into the HTML Telegram accepts, for sending with parse_mode HTML. Telegram's HTML has only bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, links, code, pre and blockquote, so headings become bold lines, list items bullet or numbered lines, tables a monospaced block and rules a line of dashes; raw HTML in the source is shown as text, and links Telegram cannot open keep their text only. Soft line breaks stay newlines. Takes a string, {markdown}, {text}, or a reply hook's own {response, via}; returns {text, parse_mode: "HTML"}. To format an agent bot's replies, create it with "replyOperation": "v/ops/telegram/format": a reply hook's parse_mode wins over the bot's parseMode. An application with its own replyOperation calls this after its own processing and returns its text and parse_mode. The adapter splits a long reply at a line break where it can, so inline formatting nearly always stays whole; a part whose tags the cut separates, most often a code block or quote spanning it, arrives as plain text. A pure conversion: no bot and no ability.

text.description: The Markdown to convert, when markdown is absent

response.description: A reply hook's agent response: a string, or a map read for text, response, content, message or result, as the adapter reads any reply

via.description: A reply hook's context; not used

parse_mode.description: Always HTML: the parse_mode the text is sent under
